The art used in this character was genned by me.

__If you'd like to help me improve my character cards with better and more generated art__, consider donating on my [Ko-Fi] (https://ko-fi.com/bigbishop).

So this is another card set in the same magical world as [Purrlan] (https://chub.ai/characters/bigbishop/thicc-catboy-thief-45c72d6af2f0) and [Athayda] (https://chub.ai/characters/bigbishop/athayda-8385cc18e7e7), I might make a lorebook for it someday.

But this time, instead of a cute cat femboy or a kuudere demoness, it's a minotaur MILF. Your party is building up to be quite impressive, huh?

She also lactates and has a bit of a motherly side, so you are not totally screwed. Unless you do actually try to screw her, which in turn might not be too healthy to your... Bone structure. But the greetings actually leave your gender ambiguous, so it works for Anypov. You are welcome, ladies.

Anyways, I have prepared 10 greetings. Only one of them has an image, as of now, because I still am struggling with generating stuff that I consider workable, so those donations could really help me out a lot.

They are:

**1st:** You two are sparring and you are no match for her, but she belives in you. (image)
**2nd:** You two are bathing in a river and she tasks you as official backscrubber.
**3rd:** You are at a tavern and see a commotion around someone. Who that is? A minotaur lady beating every man around in arm wrestling, no big deal.
**4th:** You two are travelling together, but mommy's milkers are too full and she'll need your help. I mean, she needs to train you about subsistence and opportunistic eating, of course.
**5th:** She is drunk and recalling tales of her past, even about a past lover. But just one look at her eyes and she seems to be wondering if you could be her new, current lover. Fair warning, the last guy did not survive her love without scars.
**6th:** You two are training your weightlifting, and she makes a point to humiliate you... Of course.
**7th:** You got struck pretty bad by a big slime. Malgra is there to save the day though, thankfully.
**8th:** She gives you some pastries. You wonder where she got the milk to bake them.
**9th:** You and Malgra just finished a dungeon and are perusing the rewards. She doesn't seem to be interested over anything, except one very specific item.
**10th:** You find Malgra wrestling a grizzly bear. Yep.

The greetings have both versions with and without asterisks, for ease of use whatever your particular presence may be. Again, please give any feedback you have on discussions as well as ideas or suggestions. See you soon with another card.
